name: Working Out
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of diligence and strength in both physical and spiritual realms. Proverbs warns against laziness, urging believers to arise and act with wisdom and vigor, as seen in the example of the virtuous woman who strengthens her arms and girds her loins. The New Testament calls Christians to offer their bodies as living sacrifices, highlighting the spiritual discipline that produces righteousness through endurance and exercise. This comprehensive view underscores that working out, whether in daily labor or spiritual growth, is integral to a faithful and fruitful life.
